$comment: HIMMEL-2176 Task 5 (externalization Stage 1, PR-B, design A14/A15). Single source for BOTH the wizard's secrets step and .env.example's generated secrets block (scripts/lib/gen-secrets-doc.mjs renders it — run `write` after editing this file). Per design A8.2: descriptive metadata ONLY — never a value, never a real credential, never a path to a file this repo should read or echo. Per entry: name/storage/obtain/probe/required/feature, plus the optional `sources` (fetch-health source ids this credential feeds) and `pairedWith` (sibling credential, so a half-configured pair does not blame the wrong one) that PR-C added. `stationSecrets` lists the other secret keys a himmel script loads from the repo .env, with the script that reads each; the wizard and .env.example read `secrets` only, while scripts/lib/himmel-secrets import-env and the doctor's C75 row read the names in both lists. `feature` (HIMMEL-2305) is a closed enum -- one of core|vault|cadence|bridge|whisper|lane:codex|lane:hermes (scripts/himmelctl/lib/adopter-profile.js's FEATURE_IDS, mirrored in scripts/lib/gen-secrets-doc.mjs) -- naming which recorded wizard selection this secret's feature belongs to; the wizard's secrets walk and .env.example's generated sections are both scoped/grouped by it.

secrets.name: BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN
secrets.storage: Repo-root .env (TOOL-LOADED — scripts/bitbucket reads it directly; no export needed). Unset on a GitHub repo (never invoked).
secrets.obtain: id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens -- create a token, pair it with BITBUCKET_EMAIL for Basic auth against api.bitbucket.org.

secrets.name: BITBUCKET_EMAIL
secrets.storage: Repo-root .env (TOOL-LOADED — scripts/bitbucket reads it directly; no export needed). Unset on a GitHub repo (never invoked).
secrets.obtain: Your Atlassian account email — the same account the BITBUCKET_API_TOKEN was created under.

secrets.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
secrets.storage: Process environment only — export in the launching shell or ~/.claude/settings.json "env" {}. NOT read from the repo .env: marketplace/plugins/obsidian-triage/tools/lib/follow-web.mjs and harvest-clip-body-batch.py both read process.env directly.
secrets.obtain: Sign up at https://www.firecrawl.dev/ (or self-host) and create an API key from the dashboard. Free tier: 1000 credits/mo. Last rung of the scrape chain (HARVEST_SCRAPE_BACKEND, default local-headless,jina,firecrawl) and opt-in (--firecrawl-thin) — default harvest runs never need it. Every call is ledgered to ~/.himmel/state/firecrawl-ledger.jsonl (override HIMMEL_FIRECRAWL_LEDGER). Jina Reader, the rung before it, needs no key.

secrets.name: FIRECRAWL_BASE_URL
secrets.storage: Process environment or the repo .env (follow-web.mjs and harvest-clip-body-batch.py read the environment; fetch-health.py also reads .env). No himmel.conf layer serves it.
secrets.obtain: Only needed for a self-hosted Firecrawl instance — the base URL of that deployment's API (e.g. http://localhost:3002). Omit to use the hosted api.firecrawl.dev.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.storage: ~/.claude/channels/telegram/.env (TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN key) — the bridge's OWN file, scaffolded by scripts/setup/onboard-telegram.sh. NOT the repo-root .env: a same-named key there is a DIFFERENT bot, used only by the HIMMEL_JIRA_NUDGE SessionEnd relay (see .env.example's Telegram bridge section).
secrets.obtain: Message @BotFather on Telegram, run /newbot, follow the prompts, copy the token it prints. https://core.telegram.org/bots/tutorial#obtain-your-bot-token

secrets.name: WHISPER_MODEL
secrets.storage: File at $HOME/.himmel/whisper/ggml-small.bin by default (WHISPER_DIR overrides the directory, WHISPER_MODEL overrides the full path). Read by scripts/telegram/transcribe.ts (process environment only) and himmelctl's cmd:whisper_ready probe; no himmel.conf layer serves it. Not a credential — a downloaded model artifact — but voice-note transcription is silently unable to run without it, so it belongs in this manifest per A17.
secrets.obtain: Download a ggml whisper.cpp model (e.g. ggml-small.bin) from https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/tree/main and place it at the path above. The whisper-cli binary comes from your distro package (pacman -S whisper-cpp, brew install whisper-cpp) and is found on PATH by default, else at WHISPER_DIR/whisper-cli.

secrets.name: JIRA_API_TOKEN
secrets.storage: Himmel checkout .env (TOOL-LOADED -- the Jira CLI reads it directly; no export needed).
secrets.obtain: id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens -- create a token for the account in JIRA_EMAIL.

secrets.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
secrets.storage: Station himmel.conf.local, selected profile, then himmel.conf; process env wins. Himmel checkout .env is a one-release fallback. This is a trusted credential destination; agent config writes are guarded.
secrets.obtain: Your Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://your-site.atlassian.net (https only; a host outside atlassian.net needs an explicit yes before any probe).

secrets.name: JIRA_EMAIL
secrets.storage: Station himmel.conf.local, then himmel.conf; process env wins. Legacy Himmel checkout .env is also read.
secrets.obtain: The Atlassian account email the JIRA_API_TOKEN was created under.

secrets.name: JIRA_PROJECT_KEY
secrets.storage: Station config or process env; the PROJECT repo-root .env is also read by the commit gate and Jira CLI.
secrets.obtain: The key prefix of your Jira project, e.g. HIMMEL in HIMMEL-123 (capital letters and digits).

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.storage: Process environment only — export in the launching shell. Read by the skills that call Gemini; not read from the repo .env.
secrets.obtain: Create a key in Google AI Studio (https://aistudio.google.com/apikey). EEA: the Gemini free tier is not allowed, so use a paid tier only.

secrets.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
secrets.storage: Process environment only — export in the launching shell. Read by /research and /research-deep; not read from the repo .env.
secrets.obtain: Create an API key in the Perplexity API settings (https://www.perplexity.ai/settings/api).

secrets.name: XAI_API_KEY
secrets.storage: Process environment only — export in the launching shell. Read by /x-read, /x-pulse and /youtube; not read from the repo .env.
secrets.obtain: Create an API key in the xAI API console (https://console.x.ai).
